input.quote: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice. Commerce One shall bear all costs and expenses of such inspection.
input.rationale: Section 4.4 binds us (Corio) to an audit of books and records verifying amounts payable to Commerce One. It already meets several playbook requirements: once per calendar year, independent CPA reasonably acceptable to us, Commerce One bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%. It deviates in that notice is only "reasonable notice" rather than a fixed 30 days' written notice, timing is only "reasonable times" rather than business hours, and the auditor is not expressly bound by confidentiality; there is also no express bar on access to our systems. The redline supplies these limits with a single minimal replacement, leaving frequency and cost allocation untouched.

proposal.summary: Add 30 days' written notice, business-hours limit, auditor confidentiality undertaking and no-systems-access to the Section 4.4 audit right
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a fixed 30 days' prior written notice, confined inspections to normal business hours, required the inspecting accountant to be bound by confidentiality, and confirmed the inspection is of books and records only (no access to our systems). Frequency and Commerce One's cost responsibility (subject to the 5% underpayment threshold) are unchanged; we can accept 15 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, at reasonable times and upon reasonable notice.
ops.newText: Such inspections may be made no more than once each calendar year, during Corio's normal business hours and upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, and the inspecting accountant shall first agree in writing to confidentiality obligations no less protective than those set forth in Section 10. Any such inspection shall be limited to the relevant books and records and shall not include access to Corio's systems, networks or facilities.
